versions.content: DefinitionRefPath DefinitionRefPath is a string which contains a path separated by "/", and can contain wildcards: DefinitionRefPath ::= "/"? PathPart ("/" PathPart) * "/"? PathPart ::= ( " * " | " ** " | "?" | [a-zA-Z0-9_] )+ * --> Any Sequence of [a-zA-Z0-9_] ** --> Any Sequence of ("/" | [a-zA-Z0-9_]) ? --> Any ONE of [a-zA-Z0-9_]
